## User problem

What are you trying to accomplish? Use fictional examples, not student records.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the change and how someone would know it works.

## Alternatives and constraints

What have you tried? Would this require new permissions, API access, a platform
backend, calendar mutations or migration of existing state?

## Scope

What should stay unchanged? Keep requests separate from credentials or account setup.
